name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: A titled part of a screen whose body shows and hides: "Show completed (3)", "Raw output". The header is one button with a turning chevron and `aria-expanded`, an optional `actionSlot` sits beside it rather than inside it, and `contentSlot` is mounted only while open. Uncontrolled with `defaultOpen`, or controlled with `open`/`onOpenChange`.
